head: Amazon Prime adds Uber Eats: free delivery on food orders over $25
dek: Amazon Prime members in the US can now order restaurant takeout from Uber Eats inside the Amazon app or website, with no delivery fee on orders of $25 or more. No Uber account is needed.
details: You pay with your Amazon payment methods; Amazon handles the order and delivery alerts, and Uber Eats sends the receipt. Uber Eats becomes the official restaurant delivery partner for Prime in the US.
where: US, Prime members, Amazon app and website
means: If you have Prime, you can order takeout without another app or account, and skip the delivery fee on bigger orders.
todo: Look for restaurant delivery in the Amazon app. Check the total, since other fees and the menu prices still apply.
